question: Krishnarao Shankar Pandit belonged to which of the following music gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gwalior gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Gwalior gharana:**

 
 
• Krishnarao Shankar Pandit (1893-1989) was a prominent Hindustani classical vocalist belonging to the Gwalior gharana. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• The Gwalior gharana is considered one of the oldest and most influential gharanas of Hindustani classical music. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• He was known for his clear diction, precise intonation, and traditional style of singing.
 
• He was a dedicated teacher and trained numerous disciples, contributing significantly to the preservation and propagation of the Gwalior gharana's legacy.
